## About
KGZ Collision center is an auto body shop at 1401 25th Ave, Unit D, in Melrose Park. We handle collision and structural repairs, paint repair, paintless dent removal, towing and detailing, and our technicians work to bring your vehicle back to its original condition.
We know an accident is stressful, so we try to keep things simple. We give free estimates, walk you through the insurance claim and keep you updated while your car is with us. Our goal is clear pricing and good work that gets you back on the road safely.
We're rated 5 on Google from 108 reviews. One reviewer thanked Bek and his team for turning a very unfortunate situation into a positive one.

## Services
- Collision and structural repair: Repairs after an accident, from cosmetic damage to structural work, using advanced equipment to restore your vehicle.
- Bumper and paint repair: Fixing damaged bumpers and paint so your car looks right again.
- Paintless dent removal: Removing minor dents and dings while keeping your original paint finish.
- Glass, diagnostics and calibration: Windshield and glass replacement, plus vehicle diagnostics and calibration.
- Free estimates: We look over the damage and give you a cost projection for repairs, with no obligation.
- Insurance assistance: We guide you through the claim, talk with your insurance provider and make sure repairs are documented to their guidelines.
- Towing: If your car can't be driven, we can bring it to our shop for repairs.
- Detailing: Interior and exterior cleaning, restoration and finishing to keep your vehicle in good shape.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We work with all major insurance companies and can help you through the claim process.

Q: How long will my repair take?
A: It depends on how much damage there is, what repairs are needed and when parts are available. We'll keep you updated while your car is here.

Q: How much will my repair cost?
A: Cost depends on the damage, parts, materials and labor. We're always transparent about pricing so you know what to expect.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM. We're closed on Sunday.
